fact_overrides.quote: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Haiku 5.5 include safety classifiers that can decline a request." "Set the `fallbacks` parameter to the string `"default"` and send the `server-side-fallback-2026-07-01` beta header. quota_value.basis: List-price value of in-scope tokens divided by (weekly-window quota points used x fee per point), fee per point = monthly price x 7/30 / 100.
